title: Understanding ToText() in Business Central 2025
summary: The ToText() method, new in Business Central 2025 Wave 1, converts various data types to text using default formatting without accepting additional parameters. The post demonstrates how ToText() outputs look for decimal, integer, byte, boolean, date, time, datetime, duration, GUID, and version types, comparing results to the Format method.
key_points: ToText() is a new method in BC 2025 Wave 1 that quickly converts variable values to text strings with default formatting
Date and time types accept a boolean parameter that switches between locale and invariant formatting
ToText() maintains full decimal precision for decimals, unlike the default Decimal field display which restricts to two decimals
Special formatting behaviors include byte values showing ASCII integer values, GUID values omitting braces, and two-digit month/day/year expressions for dates

quotes.text: This is not a replacement for the Format method but provides a quick way to format a value for display.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the purpose and scope of ToText() as a convenience method rather than a full replacement for existing formatting approaches

quotes.text: The ToText() will function across the full precision of the value.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a key difference from default field display, showing ToText() preserves decimal precision rather than truncating it
